label: Universal well-founded prior credentialing excludes thin belief reasons
description: From an assumed thin reason, presentation supplies a particular attributed consideration for that belief. Each active reason has a justified credential, and prior transfer supplies another active reason for its credential at the same subject, prior to the original. Well-founded induction excludes every such active instance. This is a conditional derivation of the existing thin nihilism proposition, not a defense of nihilism or a premise that all epistemic dependence is well-founded.
